lines.text: What's the first thing a medical device maker asks about a battery? Where did the cells come from!
Named cells, with the datasheet and safety data sheet included.
Every batch and date code is traceable, with a test report in every shipment.
And the B M S tells your device exactly how much charge is left.
Certification? Reviewed for every project, like U N thirty-eight point three and I E C six two one three three.
[excited] Traceability or runtime... what matters most to you? Tell us in the comments!
